additions.site_name: Microsoft Dublin Data Center Campus, Grange Castle Business Park, Nangor Road, Clondalkin, Dublin 22
additions.name: Microsoft Dublin Data Center Campus — operating DUB14 and DUB15 installation with the Central Administration Building (EPA IE licence P1187-01; DUB15 build-out not asserted complete)
additions.site_identity_review: EPA IE licence P1187-01 is held by Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited for the 'Microsoft Dublin Data Center Campus, Unit 74-76 Grange Castle Business Park, Nangor Road, Clondalkin', the same campus name and address as the existing Atlas site and its P1191-01 project. Microsoft's 22 September 2026 letter to the EPA (already evidence on this site) shows one COMAH boundary containing the P1191-01 site to the east and the smaller P1187-01 site to the west. The 2025 AER states that P1187-01 covers DUB14, DUB15 and the CAB administration building, and the licence introduction ties its gas engines to DUB 15. The register grid reference N231237 E303206 transforms to a point 430 m west of the inherited campus locator, 11 m from the national planning register point of SD21A/0203 (the amended DUB14/DUB15/CAB permission on lands west of the existing Microsoft campus) and 24 m from ED24/0060 (temporary generators at the Dub15 building 'within the Microsoft Campus'). This is therefore a further installation of the existing campus, distinct from the P1191-01 project (DUB6-DUB13) and from P1190-01 (DB3-DB5).

status.summary: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited's 2026 annual noise survey under IE licence P1187-01 (AWN Consulting report 267501.0593NR01, issued 31 August 2026 and posted to the EPA's LEAP site on 1 October 2026) states that Microsoft operates a facility at Unit 74, Grange Castle Business Park under licence P1187-01 and that 'The facility operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week'. The licensee's 2025 AER identifies the P1187-01 installation as DUB14, DUB15 and the CAB administration building. This supports current operation of the licensed installation on 31 August 2026. The same AER reports DUB14 fully loaded in 2025 and DUB15 in phased deployment and commissioning with the remainder of its site under construction, so completion of DUB15 or of all its halls is not asserted, and the survey's July measurement days are not used as the observation. No IT capacity is stated; the 22 gas engines and 21 diesel generators are standby plant.

locator.identity_review: Reuses the existing Microsoft Dublin Data Center Campus point exactly: the EPA register site-centre grid reference of the P1191-01 installation (N231310 E303630, transformed once with pyproj 3.7.1), with its pinned geometry evidence and no geometry-identity evidence rows. The existing precision already states that the campus extends about 700 m west and north-west and that the P1187-01 installation point lies 430 m away. The point does not locate DUB14, DUB15 or the CAB building; the P1187-01 register point is used only as an identity cross-check (geometry facts) and is not published.

additions.distinctness_review: Screened on 27 October 2026 against the names, aliases, operators, addresses and coordinates in all five tables (sites.csv, projects.csv, evidence.csv, source-records.json, identity-mapping.json) of the current dataset verified_construction_core/2026-10-27-research-eightyseventh (770 sites, 823 projects, 4,291 evidence rows, 231 source records; first screened against eightysixth, which the base replaced during this pass by adding three English sites), every sources/*-holds.json file, all other queue fragments' changes and holds, and claims.tsv. Searched Microsoft Dublin, Grange Castle, Unit 74, Unit 75, DUB14, DUB15, CAB, Central Administration Building, P1187, SD20A/0283, SD21A/0203, ED24/0060, D22 A259 and Microsoft Ireland Operations. The only Atlas matches are the existing Microsoft Dublin Data Center Campus site and its P1191-01 project (DUB6-DUB13), whose evidence already cites the P1187-01 noise survey and the CRAMP letter as campus context, and Microsoft Huntstown (a separate campus 12.9 km away). No Atlas project names DUB14, DUB15 or P1187-01 as its scope. The thirty-fourth hold 'Microsoft Dublin Grange Castle campus: DUB14 and DUB15 data centres and Central Administration Building (SD20A/0283/EP)' and the ie-p2 / fifty-sixth lead for P1187-01 and P1190-01 are the same buildings; this addition follows their reopen conditions (a dated in-window record of operation, added as a project reusing the campus locator exactly). Atlas records within 2 km of the inherited campus point: the host Microsoft site and its P1191-01 project (0 km), EdgeConneX Dublin campus, Newcastle Road, Lucan (1.16 km; 0.88 km from the P1187-01 point and 0.48 km from the P1190-01 point; a different operator west and north of the Microsoft land) and Google Ireland Grange Castle campus with its Grange Castle South expansion project (1.03 km; a different operator and business park south of the Nangor Road). Held candidates within 2 km: the thirty-fourth hold for Microsoft DUB14/DUB15 (SD20A/0283/EP, 190 m), the fifty-sixth Google PPK1/PPK2 hold (Google campus), the Vantage DUB11 Profile Park hold (P1227-01 register point 0.59 km south, a different operator) and this fragment's own EdgeConneX DUB01/DUB02 addition (0.90 km). No other queued addition or claim lies within 2 km.
additions.successor_review: The LEAP document list for P1187-01 (captured 26 October 2026 UTC) ends with an Annex I spreadsheet posted on 21 October 2026, after the 2026 noise survey; the LEAP licence record shows P1187-01 Licensed with no surrender, transfer or expiry. Nothing reports closure, pause or decommissioning of DUB14 or DUB15. Operation is kept as of 31 August 2026, 57 days before a 27 October update; DUB15's remaining build-out is a possible later refresh, not asserted here.

additions.site_name: EdgeConneX Dublin campus, Newcastle Road (R120), Lucan, Co. Dublin
additions.name: EdgeConneX Dublin campus — existing DUB01 and DUB02 data centres east of the R120 (operating)
additions.site_identity_review: The existing Atlas site is EdgeConneX's Dublin campus on Newcastle Road (R120), whose only project is the EPA-licensed EDCDUB04/EDCDUB05 installation west of the R120; its locator precision already records that 'the existing EdgeConneX buildings DUB01 to DUB03 lie east of the R120'. The EPA inspector's December 2025 report (already evidence on this site) states that the R120 divides the lands under the applicant's control, with the licensed installation to the west and the existing data centre campus, including DUB01, DUB02 and DUB03, to the east. EdgeConneX's Dublin page describes a single land-banked parcel that houses two existing data centres and up to five new ones. National planning register records east of the R120 in Ballymakaily and The Grange (SD16A/0214, SD16A/0345, SD17A/0141, SD18A/0298 and SD20A/0031, the last describing works 'within the Edgeconnex campus' beside the data centre 'granted and built' under SD17A/0141) lie 421-462 m east of the campus point. DUB01 and DUB02 are therefore a further project of the existing campus, distinct from EDCDUB04/EDCDUB05.

status.summary: EdgeConneX's Dublin location page, headed 'DUB01 & DUB02 Dublin Data Centers', in its version modified on 27 August 2026 (bounded by Internet Archive copies of 2 August and 3 September 2026), says EdgeConneX holds a land-banked parcel in Dublin that currently houses two purpose-built data centers, that it is operational and power banked for over 170 MW, and that it supports two existing and up to five new data centers in the Grange Castle Business Park; it lists DUB01 at 18 MW N+1 and DUB02 at 7 MW N+1. This supports current operation of the two existing data centres east of the R120 as of 27 August 2026. The page marks a 7 MW DUB03 as planned, while the EPA's December 2025 report counts DUB03 in the existing campus; DUB03's state is not asserted. The licensed EDCDUB04/EDCDUB05 project west of the R120 is unchanged and no new building or capacity is added; the MW figures are N+1 facility ratings, not measured IT load.

locator.identity_review: Reuses the existing EdgeConneX Dublin campus point exactly: the EPA register site-centre point of the P1204-01 installation west of the R120 (values 302644/231915 read with axes corrected, transformed once), with its pinned geometry evidence and no geometry-identity evidence rows. Its precision already says that it locates the licensed part of the campus and that DUB01 to DUB03 lie east of the R120. The point is about 420-460 m west of the DUB01/DUB02 planning-register points and does not locate either building; no new coordinates are published.
